question: Which of the following is correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sultan Khan** is correctly matched with the **Sarangi**.
 
• Sultan Khan was a renowned Indian sarangi player and vocalist.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Bhushan, India's third highest civilian award, in 2010.
 
• His mastery over the sarangi and contributions to Indian classical music are highly respected.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hariprasad Chaurasia** is a famous flutist, not a sarod player.
 
• **Zakir Husain** is a renowned tabla player, not a sitar player.
 
• **Bismillah Khan** was a legendary shehnai player, not a tabla player.
 
• The sarangi is a bowed, short-necked string instrument from India, known for its rich, resonant sound.
